questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest speed you are allowed to drive on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to avoid stopping their vehicle in the intersection ahead. Keep the intersection clear for traffic to pass through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted speed if conditions are bad, such as rain, snow, or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve to the right ahead. Slow down and be ready to adjust your steering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to drive to the right because there is an island, median, or barrier ahead. Stay on the side the arrow points to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at this sign. Let all other vehicles and pedestrians pass first, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Slow down and watch for people walking.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign tells you that the right lane ahead is closed. Move to another lane and drive carefully through the construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means that action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you of an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready to stop for a red light, slow down for a yellow light, or watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm downward, they are signaling that they are going to stop. Be prepared to slow down if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you to be careful in construction zones. This sign tells you to follow a detour because the normal road route is closed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that loose gravel is ahead. Drive with extra caution because your tires will have less traction on gravel than on pavement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm upward, they are signaling that they are going to turn right. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions to safely navigate through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones. Do not pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules you must follow. A red circle with a red slash through it means the action is prohibited. This sign means U-turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest legal speed you may drive. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules you must obey. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules you must obey. This sign tells you that from this lane, you may turn right or go straight through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane reserved only for left-turning vehicles. You cannot use this lane to pass other cars or to drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you to be ready to stop for a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction. This sign tells you that penalties for unsafe driving are higher in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming.
